text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating opening that links the rescue report to the prior judgment scene before the assertion frame begins

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: compact opening assertion bundle joining resumption, emphasis, and realization

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the rescue report attached to the prior judgment scene instead of letting it begin as an isolated notice. Because it is fused into {{ar:وَلَقَدْ}} ({{tr:wa-la-qad}}), continuity and verification arrive as one compact opening: the listener first hears narrative resumption, then the certainty frame, then the rescue action. The short opening cadence makes that transition quick rather than leisurely.

topics.headline: resumptive opening after judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deliverance report is heard as continuation after judgment, not as a detached new report.
topics.reason: The particle opens the same confirmed verbal clause and supplies coordination or resumption at the ayah boundary.

topics.headline: visible fusion into the assertion frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees continuity and emphatic verification entering together in the compact opening bundle.
topics.reason: The surface bundle {{ar:وَلَقَدْ}} ({{tr:wa-la-qad}}) combines the opener with the following assertion particles before the finite verb.

topics.headline: short particles create quick entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the clause move rapidly from boundary resumption into the longer rescue verb.
topics.reason: The short pre-verbal particles precede the longer lexical verb, and the boundary gives the opening its resumptive target.

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion marker bound to the following realization particle, not a preposition governing a noun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the assertive marker inside {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:la-qad}}), not a preposition looking for a noun. It front-loads certainty before the rescue verb is heard, so the deliverance enters as a certified report rather than a neutral narration. Its tight attachment to the following particle keeps oath-answer pressure, emphasis, and verification in one small frame, and the move from smooth liquid onset into stop-heavy closure gives that frame a clipped, decisive sound.

topics.headline: emphatic marker, not preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small letter strengthens the whole verbal report rather than introducing a prepositional phrase.
topics.reason: The bundle grammar marks {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) as the emphatic element before {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), with no governed noun.

topics.headline: oath-answer pressure and assertion force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rescue stated as a claim resistant to doubt before the event itself is named.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:la-qad}}) stacks emphatic assertion with realized perfect aspect before {{ar:نَجَّيْنَا}} ({{tr:najjaynā}}).

topics.headline: liquid-to-stop assertion texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the opening harden quickly as the smooth emphatic letter moves into the stop-heavy realization particle.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the immediate sequence {{ar:لَقَدْ}} ({{tr:la-qad}}) and supports the compact assertion frame.

words.gloss_range: realization particle before a perfect verb, verifying the completed rescue event rather than marking possibility
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) verifies the rescue because it stands before the perfect verb {{ar:نَجَّيْنَا}} ({{tr:najjaynā}}). Its broader modal range is narrowed here by the perfect form: this is completed deliverance, not possibility or promise. The particle also scopes over the event as a whole, so the named people and the source of escape are brought under one certified report.

topics.headline: perfect selects realized completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rescue is presented as accomplished fact, not as a possible or merely anticipated rescue.
topics.reason: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) can have broader uses, but the following perfect verb locally selects realized verification.

topics.headline: verification covers the rescue claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole deliverance claim certified, including rescued object and escaped source, rather than only the bare verb.
topics.reason: The confirmed verbal clause includes the verb, direct object, and {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) source complement under the opening frame.

topics.headline: certainty arrives before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears verification as a hinge into the rescue action before the action word itself opens.
topics.reason: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) sits between the emphatic marker and the finite verb, creating a compact pre-verbal certainty frame.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person plural causative rescue: externally effected extraction of a named object from a hostile source-domain
words.root_gloss_range: root field of getting clear, safety, escape, and separation from danger; the Form II local frame selects caused rescue rather than self-escape

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the named lineage as rescued object

words.prose: {{ar:نَجَّيْنَا}} ({{tr:najjaynā}}) is the ayah's only finite action and it enters after the certainty particles as an already achieved divine rescue. Form II and the direct object make the event an externally effected extraction of {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}), while {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) names the field from which they are removed. The root's getting-clear image survives as movement out of danger, but the local grammar keeps the people as rescued objects rather than self-escaping subjects. The wording also recalls the Pharaoh-context rescue formula (2:49; 7:141; 14:6; 20:80) and answers the denied reprieve of the prior scene (44:29) with completed extraction.

topics.headline: completed divine rescue action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees rescue as both achieved and explicitly agented by the divine speaker through the verb form itself.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect with first-person plural subject marking under the {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) realization frame.

topics.headline: Form II turns escape into caused extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that deliverance is not self-survival; the people are acted upon and brought out of a hostile domain.
topics.reason: The direct object and {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) complement select caused rescue from a source-domain; broader escape language is kept as root pressure, not as a local intransitive parse.

topics.headline: verb organizes actor, object, and source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can map the clause as divine agent, named rescued object, and punishment-source arranged around one verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}) as direct object and {{ar:مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:mina al-ʿadhābi}}) as source complement.

topics.headline: Pharaoh-context rescue formula compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this single clause as part of the broader Quranic memory of rescue from Pharaoh-context punishment.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete rescue parallels and formulaic pairings in Pharaoh-context passages (2:49; 7:141; 14:6; 20:80).

topics.headline: completed rescue answers denied delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene boundary moving from denied reprieve for one group to decisive extraction for the named people.
topics.reason: The contrast is semantic rather than a repeated root: the prior ending denies delay (44:29), and this verb states completed rescue.

topics.headline: central finite verb after three particles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action enter only after continuity and certainty have been established.
topics.reason: The confirmed verbal clause is organized around this finite verb after the three opening particles.

topics.headline: geminated causative pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the causative form concentrate agency in the doubled middle of the rescue verb.
topics.reason: The local surface is Form II with first-person plural suffix; the supplied Form IV comparison is useful only as a form contrast, not a replacement for the local stem.

words.gloss_range: construct collective lineage head, functioning as the rescued direct object and completed by the following proper name
words.root_gloss_range: root field spanning building, forming, and descent; locally selected as lineage membership with structural-continuity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}) is both the rescued object and the construct head that waits for {{ar:إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:isrāʾīla}}) to complete it. The phrase therefore identifies a definite lineage, not loose individuals or generic children. The root's building field gives the lineage a sense of structured continuity, while the local construct keeps the selected sense at descendants or peoplehood. As a recognized Quranic people-name, the construct phrase is placed here in the rescued-object slot rather than as direct address, so the memory of the named people is narrated as completed rescue. By naming the lineage before the danger-source, the ayah makes preserved identity the middle of the rescue clause, and the long construct ending leans audibly into the proper name that completes it.

topics.headline: construct head and direct object together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rescued object is grammatically a defined lineage phrase, not an indefinite crowd.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}) the direct object while {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}) governs the following proper name in iḍāfa.

topics.headline: descendants rather than generic sons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees rescue applied to peoplehood as a collective continuity rather than to scattered individuals.
topics.reason: The construct with a proper name narrows the broad sons or children range to lineage-membership and collective descendants.

topics.headline: building image colors lineage continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel peoplehood as a built continuity preserved through rescue, while still reading the local noun as descendants.
topics.reason: The weak-radical dispute does not create a semantic split; the local form selects lineage while allowing the root's structural image to remain as pressure.

topics.headline: fixed people-name formula in rescue memory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the phrase as a recognized Quranic people-name placed in the rescued-object slot.
topics.reason: The source rows connect the phrase to covenantal address (2:40) and rescue contexts (2:49; 7:141; 14:6; 20:80), while the local syntax makes it third-person object.

topics.headline: identity named before danger-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah centers the rescued lineage before naming what they escaped.
topics.reason: The direct object phrase precedes the {{ar:مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:mina al-ʿadhābi}}) source phrase, shifting attention from unnamed destroyed referents (44:29) to named preserved peoplehood.

topics.headline: long vowel leans into the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the construct head leaning forward into the proper name that completes it.
topics.reason: The construct form is incomplete without the following genitive, and the long final sound supports that forward dependency.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name completing the construct lineage phrase and anchoring the rescued people by inherited identity
words.prose: {{ar:إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:isrāʾīla}}) completes the open construct of {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}), so the rescued object becomes a named lineage. The proper name contributes reference rather than an Arabic root description: identity is inherited and anchored, not derived from a local quality. Because the name belongs to a stable cross-surah lineage formula, the wording feels recognized rather than newly coined. Variant pronunciations and hamza handling affect the name's acoustic path, but they do not disturb the construct relation or the rescued-object role; the internal hamza still marks the borrowed name as a recitational pressure point. Placed before the source phrase, the name closes the identity beat before the ayah turns to danger.

topics.headline: proper name completes the lineage construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rescued group anchored by a proper name inside a single object phrase.
topics.reason: The name is the genitive second term of the iḍāfa headed by {{ar:بَنِىٓ}} ({{tr:banī}}).

topics.headline: foreign name supplies inherited reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name identifies ancestry rather than describing the group through an Arabic lexical quality.
topics.reason: The QAC form is a foreign proper noun with no local Arabic root; its force is referential definiteness.

topics.headline: variant sound does not shift syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish live recitational texture from a change in identity or grammar.
topics.reason: The cited variants alter compression, long-vowel, or hamza handling while preserving the same proper-name reference and construct syntax.

topics.headline: recurrent people-name formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the name as part of a stable cross-surah lineage formula rather than a newly coined label.
topics.reason: The distributional rows treat {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}) as a recurring name formula.

topics.headline: name closes object before source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the named identity sealed before the ayah pivots to the humiliating source of escape.
topics.reason: The proper name ends the direct-object phrase immediately before {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) introduces the source phrase.

topics.headline: hamza marks borrowed-name texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the name as recitationally marked inside the otherwise flowing object phrase.
topics.reason: The hamza and long-vowel features create texture in the proper name without changing its grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: source and separation preposition introducing the danger-domain exited by rescue
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the hinge that turns the clause from rescued identity toward the field left behind. It governs {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}), so punishment is not destination or scenery but the source-domain of removal. The compact preposition carries the governing load, and its nasal shape audibly binds the function word to the punishment noun it governs. Because the phrase follows the named object, the ayah first fixes who was rescued and then lands on what they were rescued from. The same source-preposition has forward uptake in the next ayah's oppressor-source (44:31), while the prior oppressive background becomes the field from which Israel is removed.

topics.headline: source-domain of rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes punishment the field exited by rescue, not a loose location.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) as the source complement of the rescue verb.

topics.headline: pivot from identity to danger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the object phrase completed before the source of escape is delayed to the final beat.
topics.reason: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) follows {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}), pivoting from rescued identity to the escaped domain.

topics.headline: small form carries governing load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a compact particle audibly and grammatically binds the following punishment noun to the rescue frame.
topics.reason: The preposition immediately governs the definite noun and the nasal sequence supports the tight local linkage.

topics.headline: source relation bridges scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source relation carry the prior oppressive background into the rescue clause and prepare the oppressor-source named next.
topics.reason: The row's forward contrast is concrete: 44:30 names the danger-domain and 44:31 names the oppressor-source with another {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite punitive affliction as the source-domain exited by rescue, sharpened by the following humiliating modifier
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes torment or punitive affliction and, in other branches, pleasant freshness or sweetness; the local prepositional frame and modifier select punishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source and separation preposition governing the punishment noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) is the definite head of the final source phrase: rescue exits an identifiable punitive field. Its root range has other branches, including pleasant freshness, but the frame with {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and the modifier {{ar:ٱلْمُهِينِ}} ({{tr:al-muhīni}}) select torment and suppress the sweetness branch. The article and liaison bind the phrase audibly and visibly, while the article-drop variant makes the canonical definite adjective relation stand out as the local form. The noun is not the direct object of rescue; it defines the danger-space left behind, a sustained afflictive condition rather than a single strike. Its recurrence in Surah 44 makes this rescued-from punishment an earlier pole in the surah's punishment arc (44:12; 44:56), and the Pharaoh rescue formula is compressed here from wider parallels (2:49; 7:141; 14:6). The prior unnamed aftermath (44:29) is thereby tied to the degrading punishment field that this clause says Israel has exited.

topics.headline: definite head of final source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as the identifiable domain from which rescue removes the lineage.
topics.reason: The noun is definite genitive after {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and heads the final prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: humiliating modifier locked to the head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees humiliation grammatically bound to the punishment, not floating as a separate predicate.
topics.reason: The following adjective agrees with {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) in definiteness and genitive case.

topics.headline: negative branch selected over sweetness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selected punishment sense more sharply because other root branches are locally excluded by frame and modifier.
topics.reason: The root's broader range survives as contrast, while {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) plus {{ar:ٱلْمُهِينِ}} ({{tr:al-muhīni}}) selects punitive affliction.

topics.headline: punishment is danger-space, not rescued object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader maps the noun as the field escaped after the named object has been identified.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ}} ({{tr:banī isrāʾīla}}) the object and {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) the governed source complement.

topics.headline: punishment as ongoing condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the danger as an afflictive condition carrying moral and status harm, not a single blow.
topics.reason: The noun names punitive affliction and is further specified by the humiliating modifier.

topics.headline: article-drop variant tests the canonical phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the canonical article and adjective agreement more clearly because the variant exposes an alternate relation pressure.
topics.reason: The article-drop reading is useful as contrast, while the aligned local surface remains the definite adjective phrase.

topics.headline: punishment thread and rescue formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this noun inside a larger punishment-and-deliverance memory rather than as an isolated danger word.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the word to Surah 44 recurrence (44:12; 44:56), the humiliating-punishment specialization of 2:49, and rescue-from-punishment parallels (2:49; 7:141; 14:6).

topics.headline: article and liaison bind the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and see the source phrase as a bound unit whose sound fits the harsh afflictive sense.
topics.reason: The article after {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and the noun's consonantal texture support local phrase binding without adding a separate lexical branch.

topics.headline: prior aftermath tied to escaped punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the prior unnamed aftermath to the definite degrading punishment field that rescue exits here.
topics.reason: The boundary observation is semantic: the prior scene's oppressive field becomes the identifiable source-domain in 44:30.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive active participial modifier describing punishment as actively humiliating and dignity-stripping
words.root_gloss_range: root field of lowliness, contempt, abasement, and humiliation; local Form IV active participle selects humiliating or degrading force rather than passive lowliness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: punishment head modified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُهِينِ}} ({{tr:al-muhīni}}) seals the ayah by specifying that the escaped punishment was not only painful but dignity-destroying. Its agreement binds it to {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}), and the repeated definite form visually seals the noun-adjective pair, while its active participial form makes punishment a humiliating force rather than merely something lowly. The word participates in the recurring humiliating-punishment formula (31:6; 2:90), but here that threat-frame is reversed: the formula names what the lineage has been rescued from, and the root's concentrated active-participial punishment use makes the adjective feel marked rather than casual. As the final word, it lets the clause close on degradation escaped and dignity restored; its long final cadence links back to the denied-reprieve ending of 44:29 and lets the sound linger on abasement.

topics.headline: adjective bound to punishment head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humiliation as grammatically inseparable from the punishment, not as an independent second object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:ٱلْمُهِينِ}} ({{tr:al-muhīni}}) as the definite genitive adjective modifying {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}).

topics.headline: active degradation, not passive lowliness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the punishment as producing abasement, not merely carrying a lowly quality.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participle; the same-root qualitative comparison is useful only to sharpen the active local selection.

topics.headline: dignity-loss added to pain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes rescue as reversal of social and moral abasement, not only removal from bodily suffering.
topics.reason: The root field supplies lowliness and contempt, and the adjective attaches directly to the punishment head.

topics.headline: matched definite form seals the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated definite form visually seal the punishment phrase around humiliation.
topics.reason: The repeated article and matching genitive definiteness make the modifier formally inseparable from the head.

topics.headline: humiliating-punishment formula as escaped danger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a familiar threat formula repurposed as the danger already escaped by the named lineage.
topics.reason: The source rows cite humiliating-punishment environments including 31:6 and 2:90, while 44:30 places the phrase after {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) as an escaped source-domain.

topics.headline: uncommon root concentrated in punishment contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final adjective belongs to a concentrated punishment-humiliation association rather than a casual descriptor.
topics.reason: The profile shows {{ar:م ه ن}} ({{tr:m-h-n}}) active-participial usage strongly paired with punishment-root contexts.

topics.headline: last word closes on degradation escaped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah's final weight fall on humiliation as the specific danger reversed by rescue.
topics.reason: The adjective follows its head and completes the final source phrase at the ayah boundary.

topics.headline: final cadence links boundary themes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final long sound linger on abasement while the scene boundary contrasts erased oppressors with rescued peoplehood.
topics.reason: The cadence observations are local and concrete: the ending of 44:29 and the ending of 44:30 share a long closing sound, and the final word names humiliation as what was escaped.

topics.headline: sound lingers on abasement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final qualifier slow and linger while its form keeps active humiliation in view.
topics.reason: The same-root form echo and closing sound texture sharpen the chosen active participial form without changing the local syntactic role.

topics.headline: grammar, agency, valence, and closure converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can summarize the endpoint as rescue from an actively humiliating system, not merely from pain.
topics.reason: The final adjective is grammatically bound, morphologically active, semantically degrading, and positionally last.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2, the preposition min, and the linked nouns at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rescue is a caused severance of relation: a collective is moved out of punitive pain whose social operation is contempt and abasement, not merely given relief while remaining under it.

activation_trace.role: Separation from harm supplies the action's literal core and makes relational severance the mechanism.
Painful punishment supplies the harmful field from which separation occurs.
Contemptuous abasement specifies that the punishment attacks standing as well as bodies.

changed_reading.before: God saved the children of Israel from a humiliating punishment.
changed_reading.after: God caused a durable break between a named collective and a punitive relation that worked by pain plus contempt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object is named through bani at word 3 rather than as an undifferentiated crowd.
baseline_models.mechanism: Filiative naming makes the rescued object a continuity-bearing social body. Deliverance preserves descent, derived belonging, and the ability to remain a people against a punishment that renders its objects insignificant.

activation_trace.role: Filiation and belonging make lineage continuity, not a mere headcount, the rescued object.
Separation preserves the filiative body by removing it from the degrading relation.
Reduction to weakness or low standing supplies the threat to collective continuity.

changed_reading.before: A population was spared.
changed_reading.after: A lineage-bearing identity was kept continuous instead of being reduced to a low and disposable mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative rescue at word 2 acts upon a named built or constituted body at word 3 and removes it from the degrading predicate at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can carry a material model of extraction: a constituted collective is stripped out of an apparatus that puts persons into ordinary use until they are worn down. Rescue preserves or recovers the body's structure rather than merely changing its location.

activation_trace.role: Stripping and extracting supplies the material operation of pulling a body free from an enclosure.
Built constitution models the people as an organized body whose form can be preserved or damaged.
Being put into service and worn down supplies the degrading apparatus from which extraction occurs.
Punitive pain keeps the material analogy tied to the verse's explicit source of danger.

changed_reading.before: Deliverance is transport away from suffering.
changed_reading.after: Deliverance extracts an organized human body from a system that consumes its usefulness and degrades its constitution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rescue verb at word 2 and min at word 5 encode movement beyond the reach of the punishment at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A topological branch of rescue pictures safety as placement on separated high ground beyond an overwhelming field. The point is not upward rank but a boundary that the destructive medium cannot cross.

activation_trace.role: High separated ground supplies a spatial model of being placed beyond an inundating danger's reach.
Punitive harm is the threatening field whose reach defines the safe boundary.
Abasement prevents the spatial elevation from being mistaken for a claim about mere physical altitude.

changed_reading.before: Safety is the cessation of pain.
changed_reading.after: Safety is a newly established position across a boundary that degrading power cannot overrun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective at word 7 modifies the punishment and can describe what that punishment actively does to its object.
baseline_models.mechanism: The punishment does not only possess the quality 'humiliating'; it makes persons low, weak, light in social weight, and commonplace through use. Distinct mapped branches coexist as effects of one causative devaluation process.

activation_trace.role: Lowliness and weakness supply the reduced condition produced in the punished.
Wearing through ordinary use supplies the process by which repeated subjection depletes persons.
Lightness supplies the social-weight effect: the victims are made easy to dismiss or handle.
Contemptuous humiliation names the overt social result of that devaluation.

changed_reading.before: Muhin is an evaluative epithet attached to punishment.
changed_reading.after: Muhin profiles a technology of domination that repeatedly lowers the punished person's strength, usability, and social weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening book's branches activate a status-transfer reading: rescue removes a filiative body from an imposed class and reinscribes it as a named collective, with manumission as the sharpest juridical analogy.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the actual transfer out of the prior relation.
Filiative belonging supplies the positive identity into which the rescued are read.
Entry of a name into a register or group activates formal classification and reclassification.
A slave's emancipation contract supplies the precise but branch-distant juridical analogy for release from owned status.

structural_cues: 44:2 places a manifest book before the narrative, while 44:30 names the rescued object by descent rather than as an anonymous crowd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registry/group-entry and manumission-contract images; I supply the arrow from inscription to changed social status. A literal scripture or decree frame, without juridical emancipation, remains live.

changed_reading.before: Rescue takes a lineage out of harm.
changed_reading.after: Rescue also resembles declassification from a servile category and re-entry into history under the lineage's own name.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early context turns separation into an intelligible and controlled boundary: what was intermingled is distinguished, the limit becomes visible, and the operation is secured or restrained toward a determinate result.

activation_trace.role: Deliverance by separation is the focus operation sharpened by the contextual boundary vocabulary.
Manifest appearance makes the separating boundary readable rather than accidental.
Distinguishing one thing from another supplies controlled sorting rather than undirected scattering.
Secure completion gives the separation an ordered and durable result.

structural_cues: The sequence 44:2-4 moves from manifestation to differentiation to a secured affair before the narrative rescue appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifestation, distinction, and secure completion; I infer that these form a procedural grammar later instantiated by rescue. They may instead be only an opening cosmological pattern echoed, not enacted, in 44:30.

changed_reading.before: Deliverance is escape from a bad location.
changed_reading.after: Deliverance is an ordered act of distinction that establishes a visible, durable boundary between the collective and its oppressor's punitive claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier removal of punishment is explicitly temporary and followed by return. That contrast differentiates najjah from merely uncovering: full rescue separates the object from the recurrence mechanism itself.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the stronger, relation-breaking form of removal.
Lifting a cover supplies a reversible kind of relief that leaves the underlying relation intact.
Return after withdrawal demonstrates the recurrence that mere lifting fails to break.

structural_cues: 44:12 asks for punishment to be uncovered, and 44:15 couples a little uncovering with explicit return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible uncovering and return; I infer a lexical contrast in which rescue severs recurrence. The live alternative is that the two episodes concern different recipients and should not define one another semantically.

changed_reading.before: Saving and temporarily removing punishment could be near-synonyms.
changed_reading.after: The focus rescue is categorically deeper than respite: it breaks the relation that allows punishment to return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand to hand over God's servants, coupled with the prohibition of domination, activates a political-economic reading of the focus. The humiliating punishment is an ownership regime that appropriates service and wears down a lineage; rescue restores the persons to a different claim and social standing.

activation_trace.role: Filiative belonging supplies the collective identity that appropriation cannot rightfully erase.
Service and practiced work-skill expose labor as a possible site of degradation.
Being worn down through use gives coerced service its destructive process.
Performance or delivery of a right frames release as an obligation owed, not a discretionary favor.
Enslavement supplies the ownership relation that the command to hand over the servants contests.
Domination and seizure of ascendancy identify the coercive direction of that ownership relation.

structural_cues: 44:18 demands that the servants be handed over, and 44:19 immediately forbids rising in domination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies owed delivery, enslavement, service, wear, and domination; I infer that labor appropriation is the causal bridge to humiliating punishment. Political subjection without a specifically labor-economic mechanism remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is generically cruel and shameful.
changed_reading.after: The punishment is a coercive service regime that treats a lineage as usable property, and rescue is the enforced surrender of that claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The night journey and the sea left as an open gap convert topological safety into an engineered corridor. One medium is partitioned into a traversable interval for the rescued and comprehensive engulfment for the pursuing force.

strongest_changes: Temporary uncovering can recur, whereas the focus rescue severs the relation that permits recurrence.
The degrading punishment becomes a coercive service and ownership regime that wears down a lineage treated as usable property.
The night and open sea turn rescue into controlled route-making through a shared danger-space with opposite outcomes.
Later security, armor, and warding distinguish extraction after capture from prevention and settled safety.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several coexisting causal grammars rather than one paraphrase: juridical reclassification, filiative preservation, material extraction, topological passage, honor reversal, embodied incorporation, and narratable identity. Split mappings also preserved strange but inspectable night, pounding, tension, and covert-counsel resonances without promoting them to lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The registry and manumission branches of the opening book may be productive juridical activators without indicating that the text itself frames rescue as formal emancipation.
The non-dominant late-night and pounding branches of the focus adjective should remain resonances unless independent evidence justifies greater weight.
The inheritance sequence coordinates with regime change, but the packet does not force identification of its inheriting collective with the rescued lineage.
The distinction among extraction, protection, and security may be mechanistically sharper than the discourse's rhetorical overlap.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Deliverance works by extracting and separating from a humiliating regime.** `ن ج و B001/B003` supplies deliverance by separation and stripping/extraction, `ع ذ ب B005` punishment, and `ه و ن B003` abasement through contempt. The preposition `من` marks removal from an enclosing condition; I infer that rescue changes both location and imposed social valuation. The ayah reads salvation as de-subjection, not survival inside the same order.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:51's secure `مقام` and 44:56's active protection complete the rescue mechanism. Deliverance from humiliating punishment is not bare extraction; later context reveals its positive endpoint as protected residence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Deliverance is achieved by separation.** `ن ج و` `B001` defines rescue as separation from harm. The fixed clause follows an abandoned water-bearing estate and denial of respite (`44:25-29`) while explicitly separating the rescued group `مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ`. Rescue’s role is not to erase the hostile order but to place the group outside its reach. The packet supplies harm, separation grammar, and removed former holders; I infer **authorized separation -> survival from an enclosing condition**. `نَجَّيْنَا` reads as positional extraction.

2. **The rescued “children” are a preserved construction.** `ب ن ي` `B007` is filiation and derived belonging, while `B001-B002` is building by joined parts and built constitution. The named collective stands between the removal of former holders and their estate (`44:25-29`) and its own selection and receipt of signs (`44:32-33`). The building branches assign the filial name a corporate-structural role: rescue preserves a constituted lineage capable of carrying what follows. The packet supplies collective rescue and later selection; I infer **preserved belonging -> continuity of a built community**. `بَنِى إِسْرَائِيلَ` reads as social architecture as well as ancestry.

3. **Humiliating torment strips standing, not just comfort.** `ه و ن` `B003` is abasement by contempt; `ع ذ ب` `B003` is withholding or weaning away and `B005` punishment. This follows the loss of a noble station and its transfer away from former holders (`44:25-29`). The torment’s role is to reduce persons from protected standing to controlled insignificance. The packet supplies lost station, rescue, and later informed selection; I infer **withheld agency and status -> humiliation**. The ayah’s rescue restores social dignity as well as bodily safety.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The secure sequence in `44:51-57` completes rescue positively: separation from harm becomes stable standing, provision, companionship, protection, and surplus. This later completion corrected a purely negative reading of `نَجَّيْنَا`; extraction is the first phase of a rebuilt life-system.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (44:17-33) - A Water Corridor That Reverses Roles
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: One directed passage releases the enslaved and converts the pursuer's advantage into enclosure and loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night travel, a paved path, a calm opening, hydrological filling, and elevated dry ground turn deliverance into a terrain mechanism with opposite outputs for fugitives and pursuers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rescue as extraction to high ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A lineage is separated from degrading punishment by rapid extraction toward ground beyond the flood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: release by separation (`quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`); rapid departure (`quranic:root_001476:B002/m01`); elevated dry ground beyond floodwater (`quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`); lineage and descendants (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); humiliation and abasement (`quranic:root_001608:B003/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Deliverance is an extraction that preserves a lineage. Its terrain image is movement onto a rise that floodwater cannot overtake, converting escape from humiliation into spatial separation from the captor's reach.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin üzerine kurulduğu düzeni ve kişinin doğuştan gelen beden kuruluşunu doğrudan belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki yakın görünümü tek bir kuruluş biçimi çekirdeğinde doğru biçimde toplar.

error_profile.loses: İnsan dışındaki şeylerin genel kuruluş biçimini dışarıda bırakır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: قوس بانية وهي التي بنت على وترها (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ يكاد وترها ينقطع للصوقه بها (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ طيئ تقول قوس باناة (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ البائنة التي بانت من وترها وكلاهما عيب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geçerli söz öbeğini gelini götürme ve eşle birleşme anlamlarıyla açıklar, bunu yapan erkek için de bir ad verir. Aynı kanıt, başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimi kaynak dilin yerleşik kullanımı dışında sayarak sınırı açıkça çizer.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal evlilik kurumunun tamamı değil, gelinin götürülmesi ve eşlerin düğün gecesi birleşmesi çevresindeki özel kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan söz öbeği ve ona bağlı kişi adıyla sınırlıdır; reddedilen ilgeçli biçim veya genel yapı anlamı buraya alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gelini yeni evine götürmek veya erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesidir; bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için de kullanılan bir adı kapsar.

facets.statement: Gelinin yeni evine götürülmesi ve erkeğin düğün gecesi eşiyle birleşmesi.
Düğün gecesinde eşler için bir çadır kurulmasıyla açıklanan geleneksel bağlantı.
Bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek için kullanılan damat adı.
Başka bir ilgeçle kurulan yaygın biçimin yerleşik kaynak dil kullanımı dışında sayılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini götürme ile eşle birleşme anlamlarını, bunlarla ilgili damat adını ve alternatif ilgeçli biçime yönelik açık kullanım sınırını birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.text: gelini yeni evine götürme, eşle birleşme ve bunu yapan damat
concept_gloss.applicability: Düğün bağlamındaki eylem ile bu eylemi gerçekleştiren erkek adının birlikte gösterilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelini götürmeyi, eşle birleşmeyi ve bunu yapan erkek için kullanılan adı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkeğin düğün sonrasında eşiyle ilk kez cinsel birliktelik yaşaması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eşlerin düğün bağlamındaki birleşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelini yeni evine götürme görünümünü ve damat adını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Düğünde gelinin eşinin evine götürülmesi eylemi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelinin düğün sonrasında yeni evine götürülmesi eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Eşle birleşme görünümünü ve bunu yapan erkeğin adını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gelini yeni evine götürmek veya eşiyle birleşmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gelini götürme görünümünü ve eylemi yapan damat için kullanılan adı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eşle birleşmeyi belirli bir içeri girme anlatımıyla dile getiren ayrı söz öbeğine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da evlilik sonrasında erkeğin eşiyle cinsel birliktelik yaşamasını dolaylı biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelini götürme ve damat adıyla daha geniş bir düğün çevresi kurar; komşu dal yalnızca eşle birleşmeyi belirli bir giriş anlatımıyla verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düğün gecesi birleşmeyi ve bunu yapan erkek adını belirli bir söz öbeğinde toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Evlenme ve düğün yapma eylemini daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel düğün kullanımı ile genel evlenme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da düğün, yeni ev kurma ve eşlerin bir araya gelmesi çevresinde kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düğün gecesindeki götürme ve birleşme aşamasına bağlıdır; komşu dal evlenme ve düğün yapma sürecinin geneline uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Erkeğin eşiyle birleşmesini ve erkeğe verilen adı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gelinin eşine doğru götürülmesi ve teslim edilmesi yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gelinin düğün sırasında eşinin yanına götürülmesi sahnesine katılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal götürülmenin yanında eşle birleşmeyi ve damadı kapsar; komşu dal gelinin götürülmesi yönündeki eyleme odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar incelendi; birleşme, genel evlenme ve gelinin götürülmesiyle ilgili en yakın üç sınır yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: بناء الرجل على أهله ودخوله بها
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بنى على أهله بمعنى زفها أو دخل بها، والباني بمعنى العروس، مع تعليل القبة التي تضرب عند الدخول.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بنى بأهله الذي حكمت بعض المصادر بأنه من كلام العامة أو خطأ، ولا البناء المعماري المجرد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بنى على أهله بناء أي زفها (sihah)؛ الداخل بأهله كان يضرب عليها قبة ليلة دخوله بها (sihah)؛ الباني العروس الذي بنى على أهله (tahdhib)؛ بنى فلان على أهله وقد زفها (tahdhib)؛ العامة تقول بنى بأهله وليس من كلام العرب (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gerçek oğul-kız bağını, birini oğul edinmeyi ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, yetiştirilme, hizmet veya sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle aktarılan adlandırmaları birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak gerçek soy ile aktarılmış bağlılık aynı ilişkiymiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Gerçek çocukluk bağı çekirdektir; edinme ve kaynağa ya da sürekli bağlılığa dayalı adlandırmalar ayrı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çocuk ve çocukluk bağı biçimleriyle, edinme eylemini ve belirli bağlılık söz öbeklerini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak soy bağıyla bağlı olması ve bu bağın adıdır. Birini oğul edinmeye, oğulluğunu ileri sürmeye ve bir kaynaktan çıkma, onun tarafından yetiştirilme ya da ona sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılmaya da uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin oğul veya kız olarak anne babasıyla taşıdığı gerçek çocukluk ve soy bağı.
Bir kişiyi oğul edinme veya onun oğulluğunu ileri sürme.
Bir şeyden çıkma veya onun tarafından yetiştirilme nedeniyle çocuk adıyla kurulan aktarılmış bağ.
Bir uğraşa, yola, zamana veya bilgi alanına sürekli hizmet ve bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gerçek oğul-kız bağını ve çocukluk adlarını verir; toplu kanıt bunları çocuk edinmeye, köken ilişkisine ve sürekli bağlılığa dayalı adlandırmalara genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: oğul ve kız bağı, çocuk edinme ve kaynağa dayalı adlandırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçek soy bağı ile edinilmiş veya aktarılmış çocuk adlandırmalarının tümünü birlikte göstermek gereken açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek çocukluk bağını, oğul edinmeyi ve kaynağa ya da bağlılığa dayalı adlandırmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçek çocuk ile anne baba arasındaki soy bağı ve bunun adları söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek oğul ve kız bağını ve çocukluk ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Çocuk edinme ve kaynağa ya da sürekli bağlılığa dayalı aktarılmış adlandırmaları dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi gerçek soy bağı olmadan oğul sayma veya onun oğulluğunu ileri sürme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi oğul sayma veya oğulluğunu ileri sürme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gerçek soy bağını ve kaynak ya da bağlılık temelli adlandırmaları dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.text: bir kaynağın ürünü veya sürekli bağlısı
contextual_glosses.applicability: Çocuk adı gerçek soy yerine köken, yetişme, hizmet veya sürekli bağlılık ilişkisini gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Köken veya sürekli bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla kurulan aktarılmış ilişkiyi korur.
error_profile.loses: Gerçek oğul-kız bağını ve birini oğul edinme eylemini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: oğul; bir kaynaktan çıkan veya onun yetiştirdiği kimse

bir şeye kaynağı, yetişmesi, hizmeti ya da sürekli bağlılığı nedeniyle bağlanan kimse

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuk edinmeyi ve köken ya da bağlılık nedeniyle çocuk adıyla anılmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üremeyi, ardışık kuşakları ve soy için yetiştirilen hayvanları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gerçek çocukları, kuşak devamını ve soy ilişkisini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal oğul-kız adlarıyla edinilmiş ve aktarılmış bağlara uzanır; komşu dal üreme ve kuşakların devamı yönünü daha geniş işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrulanmış çocukluk bağını, çocuk edinmeyi ve aktarılmış bağlılıkları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Soyu bilinmeyen, bulunmuş, yabancı veya küçükken taşınıp getirilen çocuğa odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin çocuk olarak bir aileye veya soya bağlanmasıyla ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini oğul edinmenin yanında gerçek ve aktarılmış çocukluk ilişkilerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiyi yanlış bir soya ekleme eylemini ve böyle kimseleri belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: oğul edinme ile yanlış soya katma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal gerçek soy bağı bulunmayan bir kişinin başka bir soyla ilişkilendirilmesine değebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal oğul edinme veya oğulluğu ileri sürme çerçevesindedir; komşu dal genel olarak kişiyi ait olmadığı soya ekleme yanlışını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar incelendi; üreyen soy, belirsiz soy ve yanlış soya katmayla ilgili en açıklayıcı üç sınır yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: البُنُوَّة والنسب وما ينسب إلى منشأ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الابن والبنت والبنون والأبناء والبنات والبنوة، والتبني، وما يسمى ابنا أو بنتا لأنه يحصل من جهة شيء أو تربيته أو خدمته أو ملازمته.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا بناء البيت، ولا البنية للهيئة، ولا ألفاظ بنات الطريق والحصى إلا من جهة المجاز الاسمي.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الابن أصله بنو (sihah;mufradat)؛ البنوة مصدر الابن (tahdhib)؛ تبنيت فلانا إذا اتخذته ابنا (sihah)؛ تبنيته إذا ادعيت بنوته (tahdhib)؛ سماه بذلك لكونه بناء للأب (mufradat)؛ كل ما يحصل من جهة شيء أو من تربيته أو بتفقده أو كثرة خدمته له أو قيامه بأمره هو ابنه (mufradat)؛ فلان ابن الحرب وابن السبيل وابن الليل وابن العلم (mufradat)؛ بنت فلان وابنة فلان وبنات (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi küçük yan yolları, küçük oyuncak biçimlerini, çakıl taşını ve yerden çıkan bir otu çocuk adlarıyla anar. Ayrıca bir şeyden çıkanın onun çocuğu sayılabileceği genel bağlantıyı verdiği için geçici çerçeve örnekleri doğru bir ortak uzantıda toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek insan soyunu değil, küçüklük, dallanma veya bir kaynaktan çıkma nedeniyle çocuk adı verilen nesneleri kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kanıtlanan çoğul biçim ve söz öbeklerindeki nesne adlarını kapsar; bunları yalın çocukluk anlamıyla birleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Küçük, ana bütünden dallanmış veya yerden çıkmış bazı şeylerin oğul ya da kız adıyla anılmasıdır; küçük yan yollar, oyuncak insan biçimleri, tapınma yerindeki çakıllar, bir yer taşı ve bir ot türü bu adlandırmanın örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyden çıkma, küçüklük veya ana bütünden dallanma nedeniyle nesneye çocuk adı verme.
Ana yoldan ayrılan küçük yolların kız çocukları bildiren bir çoğulla adlandırılması.
Küçük insan biçimli oyuncakların ve tapınma yerindeki çakıl taşlarının kız çocuk adıyla anılması.
Bir çakıl taşının yerin kızı, bir ot türünün de yerin oğlu olarak adlandırılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çocuk adlarının küçük yan yollara, oyuncak biçimlere, çakıl taşlarına ve bir ot türüne aktarılmasını örnekler; ortak bağ küçüklük veya kaynaktan çıkmadır.

concept_gloss.text: küçük, dallanmış veya yerden çıkan şeylere çocuk adı verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Farklı nesne örneklerini küçüklük, dallanma ve kaynaktan çıkma bağıyla birlikte açıklamak gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuk adlandırmasını, küçüklüğü, dallanmayı ve yerden çıkma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Büyük bir yoldan dallanarak ayrılan küçük yan yollar anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Oyuncak, çakıl taşı ve ot türü örneklerini dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.loses: Yol, çakıl taşı ve ot türü örneklerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yol, oyuncak, taş ve ot gibi farklı nesnelerde küçüklük ya da dallanma adlandırmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ana bitkiden ayrılmış ve kendi başına yaşayabilen hurma fidanına odaklanır.

branches.branch_image_ar: تسميات الابن والبنت للأشياء المتفرعة أو الصغيرة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بنيات الطريق للطرق الصغار، والبنات للتماثيل الصغار، وبنات المساجد للحصى، وبنت الأرض للحصاة، وابن الأرض للبقل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا النسب البشري الحقيقي، ولا البناء المعماري.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بنيات الطريق هي الطرق الصغار تتشعب من الجادة (sihah)؛ البنات التماثيل الصغار التي تلعب بها الجواري (sihah)؛ إحدى بنات مساجد الله كأنه جعله حصاة (sihah)؛ بنت الأرض الحصاة وابن الأرض ضرب من البقل (sihah)؛ يقال لكل ما يحصل من جهة شيء هو ابنه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi göğüs kafesi kaburgalarını, ev direklerini ve bir yere yerleşip huzur bulma sözünü birlikte verir. Destek ve yerleşiklik bağlantısı dalı tutarlı kılar, ancak somut parçalar ile yerleşme eylemi tek bir nesne tanımı gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kaburga ve ev direği somut destek adlarıdır; yerleşip huzur bulma ise yalnızca belirli söz öbeğine bağlı eylem uzantısıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel çoğul biçimlerdeki kaburga ve direk adlarını, yerleşme söz öbeğinden ayrı tutar ve bunları yalın bir destek anlamına genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Göğüs kafesinin kaburgaları veya bir evin taşıyıcı direkleri için kullanılan addır. Belirli bir söz öbeğinde, kişinin bir yere yerleşip orada huzur bulmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğüs kafesini oluşturan ve bedene dayanak veren kaburgalar.
Bir evin yapısını taşıyan ve ayakta tutan direkler.
Belirli bir söz öbeğinde bir yere yerleşme, kalma ve huzur bulma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için ortak çok kaynaklı bir özet bulunmamaktadır; bütün içerik tek kaynakta tanıklanmıştır.

source_details.summary: Kaburgalar ve ev direkleri aynı ad çevresinde verilir; bir söz öbeği de yerleşip huzur bulmayı anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: kaburgalar veya ev direkleri; yerleşip huzur bulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Somut destek adları ile yalnızca belirli söz öbeğinde görülen yerleşme uzantısını birlikte göstermek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaburga ve ev direği adlarını ve yerleşip huzur bulma uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir evin yapısını taşıyan dikey desteklerden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapıyı taşıyan somut destek parçalarını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaburga adını ve yerleşip huzur bulma söz öbeğini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sonucu özellikle yenilen yiyeceğe bağlar; komşu dal neden belirtmeden şişmanlık durumunu ve genel şişmanlatmayı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyeceğin eti büyütmesine odaklanır; komşu dal az girdinin yeterli olması ve etkisinin çabuk görünmesi özelliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yenmiş yiyeceğin bedendeki eti büyütmesi sonucunu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tatma, yeme ve açlığı gideren yiyeceğin kendisini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yiyeceğin yenmesi ve beden üzerindeki etkisiyle aynı beslenme sahnesine katılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yemekten sonra etin büyümesi sonucudur; komşu dal tatma, yeme ve yiyecek kavramının kendisini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, suyun tatlı, hoş ve tuzlu olmayan niteliğini merkeze alırken kolay tüketilen başka yiyecek ve içecekleri de kapsar. Tatlı su arama, suyu tatlı bulma ve iki belirli sıvıyı birlikte adlandırma kullanımları bu niteliğe bağlı yan kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek tat ve tüketim hoşluğudur; cezalandırma, yeme içmeden kesilme ve sudaki yabancı madde bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hem yalın nitelik bildiren biçimleri hem de tatlı su edinme, arama veya öyle sayma yapılarıyla sınırlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Su başta olmak üzere bir yiyecek veya içeceğin tatlı, hoş ve kolay tüketilir olması; su için ayrıca tuzlu olmama niteliğini taşır. Bu niteliğe bağlı yapılar tatlı su edinmeyi, aramayı ya da bir şeyi tatlı saymayı anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir yiyecek veya içeceğin damakta hoş, tatlı ve kolay tüketilir olmasıdır.
Su söz konusu olduğunda hoş içimin yanında tuzlu olmama niteliği belirgindir.
Belirli yapılarda tatlı su edinme veya arama ve bir şeyi tatlı sayma anlatılır.
Bir ikili adlandırma tükürük ile şarabı birlikte bu hoşluk niteliği altında anar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği tatlı, hoş ve kolay tüketilen su, yiyecek veya içecektir; su edinme, arama ve tatlı sayma kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.text: tatlı ve kolay tüketilen yiyecek ya da içecek
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yiyecek ve içeceklerdeki ortak tat ve tüketim hoşluğu çekirdeğini, suyun tuzlu olmaması dahil, birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tatlılığı, hoşluğu, kolay tüketilmeyi ve yiyecek-içecek kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun tuzlu olmayıp hoş ve kolay içilmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun tatlılığını ve hoş içimini eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Başka yiyecek ve içeceklere uzanan genel kapsamı dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tatlı içme suyu bulma veya bir yerden böyle su sağlama yapılarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tatlı suyu amaç edinme ve onu sağlama işlemini korur.
